insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Addasound posted $2,867 in total sales for Week 46, up 408.4% from $564 the prior week, on 39 units, with organic sales reaching $2,764 (+647.8% WoW). Wednesday, Nov 11 was the standout day at $2,090. The Crystal SR2831 USB Headset led at $1,030 on 13 units with a 30.2% conversion rate, and the Epic 501 USB Headset added $844 on 13 units at a 19.7% conversion rate.

**Metrics to Watch —** Sales were concentrated mid-week: $0 was recorded Sunday, Nov 8 through Tuesday, Nov 10, and daily sales stepped down from $2,090 on Wednesday to $600 Thursday, $124 Friday and $51 Saturday. PPC revenue came in at $103 (-47.0%) on ad spend of $308 (prior $323). The good news is that the Crystal SR2831 and Epic 501 drew 43 and 66 sessions, and we are focused on turning that new traffic into steadier day-to-day demand.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** TACoS dropped to 10.8% from 57.34% as total sales grew far faster than the $308 in ad spend. ROAS was 0.33x (prior 0.60x) at a 299.5% ACOS, with a solid 0.63% ad CTR but a 0.53% ad conversion rate, so ad clicks are not yet turning into enough orders and spend is being redirected toward the products that convert.

**Actions This Week —** We will shift ad budget toward the Crystal SR2831 (30.2% CVR), Epic 501 (19.7% CVR) and Epic 302 (11.1% CVR), and pause or lower bids on non-converting search terms to bring ACOS down from 299.5%. Building on the 0.63% ad CTR, we will tighten targeting to lift ad conversion above 0.53% heading into the holiday season.
